_doc: New Gotham landmarks (godot/scripts/villains/landmarks.gd). pos = [x, z] of the site centre in metres; the 19 built sites sit in the open belt around the downtown grid (|x| or |z| > 440). style picks the builder; light = interior/accent colour; ambience = synth recipe; npcs = [model id, clip] standing inside; spot = villain stand point in site space (+z faces the city). The Red Citadel already exists underground (main.gd) and is only registered here.

locations.name: Blackthorn Asylum
locations.desc: a Gothic psychiatric hospital on an isolated island, reached by a single causeway

locations.name: Grimstone Penitentiary
locations.desc: a maximum-security prison of grey cell blocks, floodlit yards and razor wire

locations.name: Vesper Tower
locations.desc: New Gotham's tallest corporate skyscraper, with a marble lobby and a server floor

locations.name: The Hollow Mile
locations.desc: a crime-ridden neighbourhood of boarded-up tenements, burning barrels and gang lookouts

locations.name: Crownpoint Financial District
locations.desc: banks, offices and luxury skyscrapers around a marble bank hall with a vault

locations.name: Ironhaven Docks
locations.desc: an industrial shipping port of cranes, container stacks and a customs warehouse

locations.name: Saint Mourne Cathedral
locations.desc: a massive Gothic cathedral with twin spires, a candlelit nave and a rose window

locations.name: The Crimson Theater
locations.desc: an abandoned historic theatre with a dead marquee, rotting velvet seats and a stage

locations.name: Blackwater Chemical Works
locations.desc: an industrial chemical processing complex of tanks, pipes and green-lit vats

locations.name: The Rustworks
locations.desc: an abandoned steel manufacturing district with a furnace hall, chimneys and slag heaps

locations.name: New Gotham City Hall
locations.desc: the domed government headquarters with a columned portico and the council chamber

locations.name: Obsidian Plaza
locations.desc: a downtown commercial square of black stone, a monolith fountain, shops and giant screens

locations.name: The Gilded Ace Casino
locations.desc: a luxury underground casino beneath a raised garden, entered down a gilded stair

locations.name: Ravencrest Cemetery
locations.desc: a historic cemetery of leaning headstones, a mausoleum and the crypts beneath it

locations.name: Nightfall Subway
locations.desc: an underground railway station with a tiled platform, tracks and a stalled train

locations.name: The Shattered Crown Museum
locations.desc: a museum of ancient artifacts with display cases, a broken crown exhibit and a rotunda

locations.name: Deadlight Amusement Pier
locations.desc: an abandoned seaside amusement park on a pier: a dead Ferris wheel, a funhouse and stalls

locations.name: Northbridge University
locations.desc: a prestigious Gothic university: a quad, a clock tower, a lecture hall and a laboratory

locations.name: The Meridian Hotel
locations.desc: a luxury hotel run by organised crime: a chandelier lobby, a bar and a penthouse tower

locations.name: The Red Citadel
locations.desc: Crimson Knight's underground headquarters beneath Citadel Square (vehicles, equipment, computers)
